summary.headline: Vettius Valens Manuscript Witnesses
summary.text: Editorial introduction to two untitled books of Vettius Valens’ Anthologies preserved in Marcianus 314, comparing related Laurentian, Neapolitan, Seldenian, Vatican, Parisian, and Hamburg manuscripts. It explains the fragmentary but important state of the Marcian excerpts and identifies contributors and textual witnesses used for the edition.
